We will now recommend content you may be interested in. We will use content you're interested in which is according to your preference profile in your user profile, and has been predicted by AI based on your device information (IMEI, IDFA, device model, system version), log information (game log-in and log-out records, game mode participation records, item tapping/purchasing/usage records, recharge records, social interaction records, words searched), gender, age, and device location information. This information will be automatically analyzed through a computer algorithm program. Please be aware that the recommendation algorithm will not match the aforementioned data with your real identity information, and we will not use your real identity for this purpose. If you do not wish to receive customized recommendations, you can disable the recommendation feature in Settings > Customization > Recommend Customized Contents. 对了，南瓜藤上有一个漂亮的南瓜面具，那是我和黑童子一起特意为你准备的礼物。只要你戴上面具，心中默念很多遍「万圣节」，说不定就能顺利通灵，还会有奇妙的事情发生。
顺祝节日愉快！
